definitions.explanation: Hair that is silver or gray in color. Can describe naturally grayed hair in an elegant or positive way, or silver-colored hair in fiction and character descriptions.

examples.japanese: {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}の{紳士|しんし}が{入|はい}ってきた。
{祖父|そふ}は{美|うつく}しい{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}をしている。
examples.english: My grandfather has beautiful silver hair.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}の{主人公|しゅじんこう}は{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}に{赤|あか}い{目|め}という{印象的|いんしょうてき}な{外見|がいけん}だ。
examples.english: The protagonist of that movie has a striking appearance with silver hair and red eyes.

notes:
{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} means silver or gray hair, with a more elegant or attractive connotation than {白髪|しらが}. Combines {銀|ぎん} (silver) + {髪|はつ} (hair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}の{紳士|しんし} (silver-haired gentleman)
- {美|うつく}しい{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} (beautiful silver hair)
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}キャラ (silver-haired character)
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}に{染|そ}める (to dye hair silver)

USAGE:
{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} portrays gray hair positively — as distinguished, elegant, or stylish. In contrast, {白髪|しらが} is neutral or sometimes carries negative associations with aging.

POP CULTURE:
Very common in anime and manga character descriptions, where {銀髪|ぎんぱつ} characters are a popular archetype. Often paired with distinctive eye colors.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {白髪|しらが}: white/gray hair (neutral, aging-related)
- {金髪|きんぱつ}: blond hair
- {黒髪|くろかみ}: black hair
- {茶髪|ちゃぱつ}: brown-dyed hair
